lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: I distrust anyone whose power I can't physically restrain.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: That fire arc you threw — how far is the blast radius when you lose focus?

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: Eleven feet, under current conditions. Why?

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: The Emberguard used to commission battle-mages. Before my time.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: They were useful. Also dangerous. The tradeoff kept going wrong.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: That's my career in one sentence.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: You study the Rift. Does it study back?

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: I think it does. I try not to think about what it learns.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: I've started relying on you. Not the same thing. Ask me again in a month.
